//: Firebase Hosting config. `public` is an ALLOWLIST — only files inside public/ are deployed. Never point this at '.', which would publish server/.env, the service account key, and every internal doc in this repo.

headers.//: index.html holds the entire app, so it must never be cached by the CDN or the browser — otherwise a deploy doesn't reach people already using the site until their cache expires.
Static assets, if any are added later, can be cached hard.
Basic hardening. The app is same-origin only and loads Firebase SDKs from gstatic, so these are safe. X-Frame-Options stops the site being embedded in someone else's page.
